messages:
anya: quick bench write-up from this morning — evented (SSE) vs websocket endpoints for llama2-13b (nf4 int8) across gcp-us-west1 (A100) and aws-eu-central1 (H100).

anya: TL;DR — at low qps (<200 r/s) behavior is similar. at sustained high qps (>1200 r/s) websocket shows ~15% lower p50, but SSE has a tighter p99 under aggressive batching.

omar: nice. what were seq len / batch / concurrency? can you paste the loadtest config?

anya: loadtest config:
```
model: llama2-13b
quant: nf4-int8
seq_len: 1024
batching: dynamic
max_batch_size: 8
concurrency_per_worker: 16
request_pattern: open-loop
```

bench-bot: results snapshot:
- gcp-us-west1 (A100): WS p50=82ms p95=220ms p99=430ms @1300 r/s
- gcp-us-west1 (A100): SSE p50=95ms p95=235ms p99=360ms @1300 r/s
- aws-eu-central1 (H100): WS p50=68ms p95=180ms p99=410ms @1400 r/s
- aws-eu-central1 (H100): SSE p50=78ms p95=190ms p99=340ms @1400 r/s
notes: SSE p99 wins in these runs because prefix/KV cache hit behavior reduces long-tail when batching inflight requests.

kai: what kernel flags / aten/cuda kernels were used? any fused-attn or custom kernels involved?

anya: runtime flags: --kernels=fused_attention_v2 --use_kv_cache_prefetch --continuous_batching=enabled
quant details: per-channel weight quant + activation calibration. tiny quality delta on code-heavy prompts; running eval suite to quantify.

omar: can you produce throughput vs latency curves (p50/p95/p99) per region and overlay batching curves (max_batch_size sweep)? need for oncall/RCA.

anya: chart uploaded: https://drive.redwood/bench/1798123456/throughput_latency_curves.png (png has p50/p95/p99 vs qps, separate lines for SSE/WS and heatmap for batch size). next tests: 1) prefix-cache cold->warm step, 2) websocket sticky routing + kernel pinning, 3) H100 kernel autotune.

kai: sg. add cost note — H100 at our batch regime is ~1.3x cheaper per-token vs A100 due to better kernel utilization :thumbsup:

srebot: scheduled follow-up job bench-job-1798123600 (starts in 2h) :robot_face:

omar: awesome, thanks all :raised_hands:
